footer.tagline: An artist scouting studio and independent record label — we market first, sign second.

home.h1_html:
We find
the sound
before the industry does.
home.lede: Amberwave scouts unsigned artists and builds real marketing behind them — playlisting, content, press, fan growth — before they ever sign a deal. When you're ready, apply to Amberwave Records directly.
home.whatWeDoP: Whether you're not ready to sign yet or you're ready right now, there's a track built for where you are.
home.card1Desc: We find artists early and build real momentum around them — release strategy, playlist pitching, short-form content, and fan-growth campaigns — with no contract required. You keep full ownership of your masters.
home.card2Desc: Our in-house label for artists who are ready to sign. Distribution, A&R development, budget for releases, and a team that already knows your catalogue from the marketing stage.
home.processH2: From first upload to signed artist.
home.step1Desc: Send us your name, your platform, and a link to your profile. Two minutes, no gatekeeping.
home.step2Desc: Our scouting team listens, checks your catalogue and growth, and maps where you're strongest.
home.step3Desc: We run a real campaign behind your next release — playlists, content, press — before any contract talk.
home.step4Desc: If it's a fit on both sides, you're invited to sign with Amberwave Records on your terms.
home.artistsH2: What it sounds like from the inside.
home.quote1: “They were marketing my music before I'd even filled out a form for a label. By the time I signed, the fanbase was already there.”
home.quote2: “I sent a SoundCloud link on a Tuesday. Two weeks later I had a real release plan I could never have built alone.”
home.quote3: “No pressure to sign anything. They just kept showing up with playlist adds and better numbers every month.”
home.quote4: “Amberwave Records finally felt like a label built for how artists actually release music now.”
home.ctaH2: Your next release could be the one we hear.

about.p: Most labels find you after you've already built an audience. We'd rather help you build it — then talk about signing.
about.problemH2: Most artists get signed, then marketed. We do it backwards.
about.problemP: The traditional path asks an unsigned artist to prove themselves alone first, then hands them a marketing team only after a contract is signed. By then, most of the real growth work — the playlist pitching, the content strategy, the audience building — should already be underway. Amberwave starts there instead.
about.diffP: Our scouting team and our label team share the same notes — nothing gets re-explained when you move from one door to the other.
about.scoutDesc: Listens to every submission personally, tracks growth across platforms, and builds a real campaign — playlisting, short-form content, press outreach — around artists who aren't signed to anyone.
about.recordsDesc: Our label arm. When an artist is ready, they apply directly — same form, same team, no cold intros. Distribution, release budget, and A&R support that already understands the catalogue.
about.lockDesc: Being scouted and marketed by Amberwave never requires signing anything. You keep your masters and your independence for as long as you want them.
about.platformDesc: We work with artists on Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube, SoundCloud, Audiomack, Boomplay, and beyond — wherever your audience already lives.

apply.p: Two minutes. Tell us who you are, where your music lives, and link your profile — our scouting team reviews every submission.
apply.messagePlaceholder: Your story, your sound, recent numbers, anything worth knowing.
apply.verifyDesc: Two photos to confirm you're a real applicant and cut down on spam. These are only ever seen by our scouting team, never posted publicly.
apply.consent: I confirm these photos are of me, and I consent to Amberwave storing them to verify this application. I'm 18+ or applying with a guardian's consent.
apply.formNote: Submitting doesn't sign you to anything. Our scouting team reviews every application and reaches out by email.
apply.successP: Our scouting team will listen and follow up by email if it's a fit. Thanks for sending your signal.

contact.p: Press, partnerships, playlist curators, or general questions — send us a message and we'll route it to the right team.
contact.faq1A_html: No — that lives on our Apply to Amberwave Records page. This form is for everything else.
contact.faq2A: No. Scouting and marketing support is free for artists we take on — we only earn once you choose to sign with Amberwave Records.
contact.faq3A: Most applicants hear back within two to three weeks.

artists.p: Scouted, marketed, and — for some — signed to Amberwave Records. Tap an artist to find them on every platform.
